website.name: DIO to DIO
website.description: A reflexive research portfolio examining how large language models reconstruct Digital Identity Optimization (DIO) and the Ontology of Digital Identity (ODI) when the framework is applied to its own distributed ecosystem.

project.name: DIO to DIO
project.description: An independent reflexive research project that examines how large language models reconstruct and explore Digital Identity Optimization (DIO) and the Ontology of Digital Identity (ODI) when the framework is applied to its own distributed ecosystem. The portfolio preserves independent model-specific interpretations and graph-theoretical analyses without ranking or harmonizing them.

dataset.name: DIO to DIO: Independent LLM Analyses of DIO/ODI
dataset.description: A curated research dataset comprising nine independently generated large-language-model analyses of the distributed Digital Identity Optimization (DIO) and Ontology of Digital Identity (ODI) ecosystem. Each report is preserved as an unchanged Markdown source and PDF, alongside a faithful HTML representation. The reports retain independent analytical approaches and are not ranked, harmonized, or synthesized.
